seed_ledger.name: Entergy Corp: gas supply to its plants in development (group 1 of 3)
seed_ledger.reason: Per plant. Arkansas 2024 IRP station 7 and station 5: NO_DC_TIE, generic resource plan placeholders with no filing for a specific plant or pipeline. Orange County Advanced: NO_DC_TIE and no supply pipeline found, plant is near done for Entergy Texas load. Traceview: NO_DC_TIE, Texas Eastern Line 31 Expansion (FERC CP26-75, 10.2 mi 36-inch loop plus 1.6 mi lateral, under 25 km) is a real project with no roster row, already left as monitor by earlier runs because no Entergy, Enbridge or FERC source names a data center. Delta Blues: NO_DC_TIE, Tennessee Gas Pipeline Delta Blues Project (blanket CP26-555, 2.35 mi 16-inch lateral plus compressor station, 160,000 Dth/d, about $58 million, in Washington County) found, but the only data center mention is a senator's statement I could not fetch to verify, so no tie shown. Not an existing roster row (MSX P7802 is a separate project). Searches run: 7. Sources checked: Power Engineering on Delta Blues (plant only, no data center); Entergy Mississippi Delta Blues page via search (no pipeline); govly reposting FERC notice CP26-555 (lateral, 160,000 Dth/d, no data center); Power Engineering on Orange County plant (no pipeline); earlier run files for Traceview (no data center).

evidence.note: FERC notice CP26-555: Tennessee Gas Delta Blues lateral, 160,000 Dth/d, no data center named
